manager.proof.rs::lemma_manager_attached.name: lemma_manager_attached
manager.proof.rs::lemma_manager_attached.rationale: tcb-allowed.md: the manager brokers the global frame partition; its abstract Upool view (uninterp) coincides with phys_view().frames (a 0-arg uninterp constant). No in-module fact links the two uninterpreted functions; the bridge is a §8 ghost-token attachment over the frame::INSTANCE / PhysMemoryManager / Upool singletons, realized only in the not-yet-done proving phase. Empirically postcondition-not-satisfied without the assume.

manager.proof.rs::lemma_kernel_alloc_one.name: lemma_kernel_alloc_one
manager.proof.rs::lemma_kernel_alloc_one.rationale: tcb-allowed.md: frame::alloc() is a free function (no self), so the kernel-frame allocation never mutates self.upool; Verus sees self@ unchanged. The post/pre/addr parameters carry the global-partition transition supplied by frame::alloc(), unprovable in-module. Empirically postcondition-not-satisfied without the assume.

manager.proof.rs::lemma_kernel_alloc_con.name: lemma_kernel_alloc_contiguous
manager.proof.rs::lemma_kernel_alloc_con.minimal_assume: frames.len() == count && kernel_frames_contiguous(frames, count) && post == pre.book_all(kernel_addr_set(frames)) && pre.all_free(kernel_addr_set(frames)) && post.wf()
manager.proof.rs::lemma_kernel_alloc_con.rationale: tcb-allowed.md: frame::alloc_contiguous() is a free function (no self); the region transition over the global partition and the contiguity/length facts about the returned frames come from the runtime allocator, unprovable in-module. Empirically postcondition-not-satisfied without the assume.

manager.proof.rs::lemma_user_bulk_err_re.name: lemma_user_bulk_err_restored
manager.proof.rs::lemma_user_bulk_err_re.rationale: tcb-allowed.md: on a mid-bulk failure the implementation Vec::clear()s the partial vector, dropping (and via Drop freeing) every taken frame and restoring the partition to its pre-call state. Drop side effects are not modeled in Verus exec semantics, so the restoration is unprovable in-module. Empirically postcondition-not-satisfied without the assume.

manager.rs::init.name: init
manager.rs::init.rationale: tcb-allowed.md: init flips the global PHYS_MEMORY_MANAGER_INIT/ready singleton; the manager-ready transition over phys_view() is a runtime singleton effect Verus cannot model. Approved external_body.

manager.rs::kernel_watermark.name: kernel_watermark
manager.rs::kernel_watermark.rationale: tcb-allowed.md: kernel_watermark reads the link-time constant config::kernel::KERNEL_WATERMARK whose value Verus cannot resolve; this accessor ties it to spec_kernel_watermark(). Approved external_body.
